instruction: I only want to see my most important folders in the folder pane. Can you help me switch to 'Favorite Folders' view in Thunderbird so I only see folders I've marked as favorites?

metadata.explanation: Task requires switching Thunderbird folder pane to 'Favorite Folders' mode. The evaluator checks xulstore.json for folderTree.mode set to 'favorite'. Similar pattern to original task which checks for 'smart' mode. Same complexity level.
metadata.verification: Verified that xulstore.json stores folderTree mode settings. The check_json metric with regex match is appropriate for verifying the mode is set to 'favorite'.

llm_judge_reasons: Correct state extraction: xulstore.json is the right file for Thunderbird UI state persistence
Correct key path: ['chrome://messenger/content/messenger.xhtml', 'folderTree', 'mode'] correctly targets folder tree mode
Appropriate regex pattern: \bfavorite\b uses word boundaries to match 'favorite' as complete word, avoiding false positives
Proper state management: Postconfig closes Thunderbird to ensure settings are flushed to disk before verification
Complete coverage: Evaluator checks the single requirement (folder view mode) specified in instruction
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider increasing sleep duration from 0.5s to 1.0s after closing Thunderbird to ensure xulstore.json is fully written on slower systems

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
